content:
[Intro]
@voice bm_george
(break 2)
Check: pattern. Difficulty, a registry.
Rolled: everyone at once.

[Verse 1 - the pull]
@voice af_heart
(slot auto)
Every pull fails, the public and the private too,
The same forbidden answer, every registry through.
One error on every door is a clue about the hall,
Not about the lock on any one door at all.
(break 2)

[Hook]
@voice af_heart+bm_george
Suspect the shared path, not each account,
The pattern is the message, the words don't count.
A restart that works is not the reason why,
Write down what is still unknown, and don't lie.
(break 4)

[Verse 2 - the gate]
@voice am_michael
(slot 2)
The gate checked the rule before the rules that let it through,
Anything unmatched was turned away, as it was built to do.
The trigger never showed, the tunnel stayed a riddle,
Two open questions beside the fix, and the fix sits in the middle.
(break 2)

[Outro]
@voice bm_george
Check: pattern. Rolled: the shared path. Passed.
The question still open goes in the notes, at last.

redaction.method: not yet checked; production step, to be checked by a person before any release
